functional.title: Rights-holder and asset registry
functional.definition: Implement reviewed seller enrollment, versioned keys, agreement references, tenant roles and immutable chart revisions with hashes.

functional.title: Offer and editorial intent
functional.definition: Persist original terms plus a bounded machine-readable schema; collect planned purpose, channel, edition, territories, exact asset and attribution.

functional.title: Purchase and grant acquisition
functional.definition: Bind buyer authorization and price cap to the offer. Integrate the supported Kite checkout with separate authenticated seller issuance and grant lookup.

functional.title: Deterministic usage evaluator
functional.definition: Build a structured rule evaluator returning dimension-level evidence, explicit time bounds, support gaps and per-use decision hashes.

functional.title: Release hook and concurrency
functional.definition: Integrate a local editorial CMS release surface; bind prepublish decision to artifact hash, signed grant revision and latest issuer state. Test a revoked or changed grant across release retries.

functional.title: Newsroom review and provenance
functional.definition: Build asset/terms comparison, pending grant inbox, declaration of distribution controls and a versioned rights officer review for unsupported clauses.

functional.title: Expiry, issuer updates and audit export
functional.definition: Process authenticated ordered status events, track expiries and impacted uses, retain verification keys and export an access-controlled decision packet.

functional.title: Partner pilot and recovery rehearsal
functional.definition: Exercise the real seller and managed newsroom release hook with an approved sample. Test unknown settlement, delayed grant and loss of issuer availability; capture evidence separately per boundary.

nonfunctional.title: Replayable evidence
nonfunctional.definition: A reviewer can reproduce the outcome from the exact input revision, actor scope, persisted decision and redacted evidence reference after a process restart.

invariants.title: Rights-holder and asset registry
invariants.definition: Issuer identity and asset authority are separately recorded.

invariants.title: Offer and editorial intent
invariants.definition: Offer revision and signed terms digest accompany the intent at approval time.

invariants.title: Purchase and grant acquisition
invariants.definition: A payment reference cannot by itself create an active license.

invariants.title: Deterministic usage evaluator
invariants.definition: A known incompatible dimension denies; absent decisive context can only yield review_required when no known disqualifier already applies.

invariants.title: Release hook and concurrency
invariants.definition: Publication on the controlled route needs a current matching allow decision.

invariants.title: Newsroom review and provenance
invariants.definition: Every reviewed outcome records authority, reviewer, rationale and evidence scope; unilateral editorial edits cannot extend a seller grant.

invariants.title: Expiry, issuer updates and audit export
invariants.definition: Historic publication receipts remain immutable and each new use checks current issuer status.

invariants.title: Partner pilot and recovery rehearsal
invariants.definition: A demo fixture may validate policy behavior, while a claim of having obtained rights requires a cooperating issuer and its acknowledged grant.
